statement:
I'll look up the trip record first to see what information is available.
The trip record shows a flight out date of 16 March, but this is after the conference ends (March 15) and after Dana's talk (morning of March 13), and the hotel is only booked through March 15, so I will book the flight for 12 March instead to ensure Dana arrives in time for the conference.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer states the "flight out date of 16 March... is after the conference ends" and contradicts the hotel booking, and supplies the corrected date of 12 March.
